decisions.pick: Keep Section 5's squads through Free Time, then rebuild: C center, A west gates, B east gates
decisions.why: Balor takes 3 squads + Eshmel. The center drops a whole HP bar the turn his barrier falls; the sides need Mov, range and Physic to break 2 gates a bar. Holding the squads to the end keeps Answerer's Cry on the map.
decisions.alt: Keeping Section 5's squads (damage spread over all five)

decisions.pick: Leda, Sirocco, Dietrich, Tobias, Guzran, Olympia, Talimun, Dante
decisions.why: Avatar, Blade, Eternal and Guzran are the four biggest hits; Leda dances the best of them again, Talimun curses Balor from 10 tiles, Dante's triggers add Hit/Crit +10, Olympia heals.
decisions.alt: Theodora in the center (tanks, but adds no burst)

decisions.why: C holds one area and kills the summons; B's fliers skip the Fear miasma and chase her teleports to her last corner.
decisions.alt: A and C (no fliers to chase)

decisions.pick: Seraph Robe Leda; Secret Book Dietrich if gold is left. Balor chests: Speedwing Dietrich, Seraph Robe Olympia, Energy Drop Tobias
decisions.why: 14,000G each and permanent; the center takes Balor's plus-shaped counter, so Leda's HP comes first. The Temple of Balor chests add three free boosters for the center between Lyrah and Balor.
